public.title: Palindrome Linked List
public.description: A singly linked list is serialized as values from head to tail. Return whether those values read the same forward and backward. The empty list is a palindrome. There are 0 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000. This JSON adaptation checks values rather than pointer identity.
hints: Compare matching distances from the two ends.
Any unequal pair disproves palindrome symmetry.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Use two indices moving inward and reject at the first unequal pair. O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
